title: Kong appoints IPO-experienced CFO Bruce Felt
summary: Hiring a CFO who has led three software companies through public offerings improves Kong's organizational readiness. It is a preparation signal, not confirmation of an IPO filing or timetable.
confirmed: Kong appointed Bruce Felt as CFO to help scale the business through its next growth stage.
Kong says Felt took FullTime Software, SuccessFactors, and Domo public as CFO and has experience with acquisitions and global expansion.
uncertain: Kong did not say that Felt was hired specifically to execute an IPO and did not announce a filing, exchange, underwriters, or timetable.
